dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY includes (.INC), MCPAREA, COMMON-SPA, and MCP DB access patterns typical of JMA ORCA
evidence: EXIT PROGRAM / STOP RUN conditional on SHELLID

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - provisional receipt data creation (仮収納データ作成) for the JMA ORCA standard medical billing software
purpose.summary: ORCR0600 creates provisional receipt/billing data (仮収納データ作成) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It processes patient insurance combinations, inpatient accounting, and daily receipt records, writing results and errors to output files. It is invoked as a batch subprogram from a shell (RECEPTX) or standalone.

notable_features: 29 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific .INC copybooks
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM parsed via UNSTRING
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses MCP (middleware) DB access pattern
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
OCCURS tables for insurance combinations and daily counts
Conditional STOP RUN vs EXIT PROGRAM based on SHELLID parameter
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (garbled in the excerpt). This is a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing system (JMA ORCA). The program is a substantial production batch program (~2600 lines) with detailed revision history in comments. No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations - likely uses display numerics throughout.
